name: Teamanda: File emails in the construction record

parameters.content:
## File emails in the construction record
Posts each incoming email, with its attachments, to the construction record (Projektakte) of the project whose number is in the subject in square brackets, e.g. `[2026-014] Delivery note`. The sender gets an email with the reason when the subject has no project number, no project has that number, or Teamanda rejects the post. Other API errors fail the execution.

**Setup**
1. Select your IMAP account in **Incoming Email** and your SMTP account in both reply nodes
2. Select your Teamanda credentials in **Find Project** and **Create Post**. The API key needs the Manage Projects and Create Construction Record Posts permissions; posts are authored by the employee who created it
3. Set the sender address in both reply nodes
4. To accept emails only from known senders or with a password in the subject, add the check to **Read Project Number**
